title: CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE fails with CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE_UNDERFUNDED
pattern: A transaction whose CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (underfunded). A 5 NRV claimable balance from an account holding 1.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
